'''Jubalene''' was was the capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Odionate]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It was a foundry world where millions of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers of various [[Species/Legends|species]] were used to build Odion's war machines.
